# ANALYSIS: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are testing the CALL VETO filter to avoid taking call loser trades on days when the EMA ribbon shows a bullish structure (specifically, when there is a break of an ascending support). The edge exists because the engine currently takes call loser trades on days like 5/07, which results in unnecessary losses. By blocking these entries, we preserve capital and improve the engine's selectivity without affecting PUT winner trades.

## Mechanism

The filter uses `market_structure.py` to detect a 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support (fires BROKEN). When this signal occurs and the trade side is CALL, the veto is triggered, blocking the entry. Exit logic remains unchanged (managed exits as per the engine: chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner, time stop 15:50 ET). The filter does not affect PUT entries as it only vetoes CALL side.
